text:
Ava - Finance: Heads up — invoice INV-2025-117 for ZenByte is 14 days overdue. Sent reminder yesterday, bounce back from billing@zenbyte.com (SMTP hard bounce).

Liam - AE: Ugh, that's the one we bumped to enterprise last quarter. I have their finance contact in SF but they were OOO last week. Who owns escalation?

Maya - CS: I've been pinging the customer success contact (carla@zenbyte.com) — got an auto-reply. They mentioned internal approval delays + a PO mismatch last call. Haven't received the signed PO yet.

Ava - Finance: We need to start a payment plan conversation if they can't pay now. Current balance $48,600. Late fees accrue tomorrow per T&C. CollectionsBot: automatic dunning email scheduled in 24h.

Liam - AE: Can we hold on late fees? Sales says they'll try to get PO approved today. If we add fees it kills the deal.

Ava - Finance: We can propose a 3-month installment plan (50% now, 25%/25%) with written agreement, waive late fees if we get first installment within 72h. Need OK from legal for an addendum.

Raj - Legal: 3-month plan is OK but we need an amendment that preserves Redwood's right to suspend service on missed installment. I'll draft a short addendum template and loop in Liam to get signature.

Maya - CS: I'll share a one-pager explaining the addendum to customer and offer to accept card or wire. Note: their card on file failed last charge (declined), looks like they rotated a card.

Liam - AE: I'll reach out to Carla and copy the CFO we have on file (cfo@zenbyte.com). Proposed message: explain PO and offer the 3-month plan + waive fees if they sign and pay 50% within 72h.

Ava - Finance: Please include invoice link in message: https://redwood.app/invoices/INV-2025-117 and say wire details attached. Also flag for collections if no response in 5 business days.

CollectionsBot: escalation ticket created #C-8492 (assigned to Ava). Automated reminder set for +5 business days.

Liam - AE: Sending now. I'll post a thread update after I get any reply.

Maya - CS: I'll prepare the addendum template; Raj, I'll DM you the draft in 30m.

Ava - Finance: Thanks. If we don't get a commitment by EOD Friday, escalate to VP Sales for hold/resume decision.

Raj - Legal: Agreed. Also recommend we document disputed line items (if any) — that might explain PO delay. Liam, can you confirm whether ZenByte disputed last month's usage?

Liam - AE: Not that I recall. They did mention a 2x spike in embedding usage mid-month; I asked ops for a usage breakdown.

Ava - Finance: Copy me on ops report. If it's a genuine usage dispute we'll need to put invoice in 'under review' and pause dunning.

Maya - CS: Ops report requested — ETA 2h. I'll post here when available.

CollectionsBot: reminder: next dunning attempt scheduled at 1750197634.

Liam - AE: Got it. Reaching out to Carla + CFO now.

Ava - Finance: Great. Keep updates short in this thread so Collections has a single place to track. :thumbsup:
